### Christmas Audio Visual Link Up

Sunday December 28th, 7pm - 11pm.

A social event featuring a mix of DJs playing a range of genres from House, Techno, IDM, Breaks, Electro, Garage and Trance.

We will also be featuring Animations and Short Films.

**DJs:** Rycy, Shane, Gilvarry & More

**Adm:** €10 / B.Y.O.B / No Glass

Tickets will be sold in advance and a limited number will be available on the evening, first come first served.
